notes: BYU (rendered, paged program list) reviewed against its official 2026-2027 program list (catalog.byu.edu/programs, 15 pages). Emphases of a listed degree are options and not counted; emphasis pages whose degree has no line of its own are held by the option-name rule and stay unrecorded (queued). University of Utah pages print no award in the program title; Utah is queued.
